posts.body:
Hello everyone,
Last year I released a game called Dark Angel on steam using RPG Maker, It was my first experience with the tool and I really liked it.
Below is information about the game, I hope you like it.
History:
The game tells the story of guardians who must protect a powerful crystal that is capable of giving powers beyond imagination to whoever manipulates it. During the years, the Soul kingdom and its allies have been protecting the crystal, but this time a kingdom called Valalha, with the help of traitors from the Soul kingdom, has started an unprecedented war. Today a new generation of new guardians joins the Soul kingdom to protect the crystal in this war.
Features:
The game is available in English and Portuguese.
Price:
0.50 Cents of Dollar.
Version:
1.2
Engine:
RPG Maker Ace

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
I might suggest - instead of looking for more places to try to sell this, why don't you spend your time working on another game?
Just looking at the screenshots here and on the Steam page, this isn't very good.
Don't get me wrong, no one
expects
it to be - it's the first thing you made! But most people don't go to one pottery class, make a crooked ashtray, and then try to get people to give them money for it.
Your mapping has a lot of problems, where you're missing corners in your walls, have random ceiling tiles in the middle of the floor, stuff like that. And you have both flawed English and incorrect formatting evident in your screenshots - why is the right third of your message box empty? (and both "soon ahead" and "here it's very dangerous" are incorrect)
Most people are going to see those obvious mistakes and not want to spend a dollar - or their time - on this game. And, frankly, you calling it "amazing" in your description reflects a bit poorly on you.
Why not spend time either polishing this to be worth money, or making another game with higher standards?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
I don't think the software matters very much at this stage.
If you
want
to spend money to get something more modern-looking and easier to customize, then get MZ. But a lot of the issues with your game have nothing to do with VX Ace.
They have to do with more fundamental stuff - how to correctly make maps in RPG Maker (any version), proof-reading your English, play testing your game before deciding it's worth money.

Gotta say, I agree with Turan's feedback here. Even though the game is like 50p, this screenshot specifically:
Has some serious implications about the quality of the product I'd be buying. Compounded by the issues Turan noted, I don't think this title is going to be a particularly lucrative endavour on your part.
There's a ton of really great resources on this forum to help you learn though, so I would say don't be discouraged! Everyone has to start somewhere.
